correctness.rationale: The exact Schubert-cut determinant is a degree-N section. A real Gram-nondegenerate diagonal specialization proves generic squarefreeness; independent evaluation at two distinct parameters yields irreducible ordered-pair incidence and thus double transitivity; an explicit quadratic collision in the same open parameter space yields a transposition, giving S_N. The result descends from frames to nondegenerate planes because the root set is GLd-invariant. Verified polynomial and projector identities are supporting finite checks, not infinite proof.

value.rationale: The cut divisor is an intrinsic Schubert-type obstacle in the motivating Grassmann distance problem. Its full Galois group supplies structural complexity absent from raw intersection/critical-point counts, prohibits rational or radical labeling for N>=5, and applies uniformly to all rational-normal-scroll ruling types in the stated family. This is a natural complete classification of the cut-cover monodromy, not an arbitrary numerical example.
